summary: Iran conducted multiple missile tests across Isfahan, Hormozgan, and Golestan provinces alongside UAV activity over East Azerbaijan, while Israeli forces maintained intensive artillery shelling and flare deployments across southern Lebanon and executed a lethal drone strike in Jabaliya, northern Gaza. Lebanese Army special operations raided a Hezbollah weapons depot in southern Beirut's Msharafieh, seizing large munitions caches. Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered an investigation into fuel siphoning at the IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar south of Baghdad.

sections.threat_assessment: Iran demonstrates accelerated missile testing tempo across multiple provinces including strategic Strait of Hormuz approaches, signaling enhanced readiness. Israeli forces maintain persistent artillery and aerial pressure across southern Lebanon sectors while conducting lethal drone operations in northern Gaza. Lebanese Army's unprecedented raid on Hezbollah depot in Beirut's southern suburbs indicates shifting internal security dynamics. Iraqi government scrutiny of Kataib Hezbollah's Jurf al-Sakhar stronghold suggests growing Baghdad-Tehran friction. Trump's reported attack deliberations and Gulf oil recovery create volatile strategic calculus.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman directly lobbied Trump against Iranian strikes citing sanctions efficacy, reflecting Gulf anxiety over escalation. Lebanese Army operations against Hezbollah infrastructure in Beirut mark significant domestic counter-militia action. Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi's probe into IRGC-linked fuel networks at Jurf al-Sakhar signals Baghdad's willingness to challenge proxy entrenchment. UN officials urge immediate fertilizer shipping corridor access through Hormuz to mitigate global food security impacts. Israeli political leadership remains deadlocked on unity government despite security imperatives.
